Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:
I have been thinking about the new layout, and while I see nothing wrong
with the old one, we did talk about several issues with the layout while at
origins.

It seems like the new lay out with make it very difficult to tell library
cards from crypt cards. Putting out a short term investment will look alot
like another vampire from across the table.

The sudden switch of the disciplines on vampires from one side to the other
will also be a source of confusion.

What I think they should have done...had anyone asked...was make the library
cards they way they are. But the vampires should have amber status bars.
So that they match the back of the crypt cards. For and easy color coding
of cards. And the amber bar for vampires should have been seated on the
right hand side of the card. Allowing disciplines to remain is relatively
the same place for both vampires and library cards. It would have been a
great place to store the red pool cost, disciplines, and clan symbol.
Instead of having stupid symbols just all over the place in no way related
to the older cards.

Just seems like, vampire wise, the art director has never even played the
game before. =(

Looks are in no way related to my intense dislike for the other changes in
the set. Just keep telling yourself...dog poo the eternal struggle.
--
Aaron
The Nosferatu Stuff

Messages.Author: Timothy F. Bowen
Messages.Body:

Yeah, and what is with changing the backgrounds of the clans. People need
those bacgrounds man, thats screwed up. The old backgrounds were pretty
damn good. The toreador are flowery, the Malks penned up in an Asylum, and
the Ventrue the traditional Royal Blue. These were good colors. PLUS,
Vitel is a LASOMBRA. A LASOMBRA, not a Ventrue. Lasombras can be Cam
Princes too, you know. And why release a turncoat as the face for the new
"Camarilla" expansion. Sure it's cool and all, but wouldn't another
character from the books be better, like that weiner toreador who gets ahold
of that gross eyeball thing. He would rule. Just think of the illustration
on that bad boy.

Tired,
Tim Bowen
Columbus, OH

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> Actually, Leopold turned out to be a Tremere Antitribu...

This part confused the hell out of me. In fact, just about the
entire end confused the hell out of me. First Victoria is told
that Leopold is her childe. Then the surviving peon !Tremere
(can't remember his name) is obsessing on Leopold then you
find out that he is Leo's sire... It just seemed that revelation
came from nowhere. Why was Leopold planted where he was?
Just to assassinate that Justicar? (another revelation that
comes from nowhere)

Sorrow
---
Through the screams of falling steel. By the light of flares and wisdom.
All the doubts I could not face. All this time I wanted more.
With a line I'll mark the past as a symbol of beginning.
To the gods whose names we've lost and the names who gave in vain.
